purpose.en: Prevent concrete placement until relevant formwork, reinforcement, embeds, openings, site conditions, testing preparation, and required releases are acceptable for the area being reviewed.

text.en: Current drawings, shop drawings, technical changes, PIE/PRIE, mix information, and required procedures are available for the pour scope.
Formwork dimensions, elevation, alignment, stability, cleanliness, openings, and joints have been reviewed.
Reinforcement size, quantity, spacing, cover, laps, anchorage, and stability have been reviewed.
Anchors, sleeves, inserts, conduits, plates, waterstops, openings, and blockouts have been coordinated.
Base or substrate, water and debris removal, access, weather controls, and testing arrangements are ready.

Unresolved critical formwork issue, incorrect or missing reinforcement, missing or mislocated embed, unresolved MEP clash, unaccepted base/substrate, incomplete required inspection, missing required hold/witness/release, testing arrangements not ready, or open deficiency that would be permanently concealed.

releaseCondition.en: Pour ready for the area being reviewed when applicable prerequisites and governing project requirements are satisfied or released by the authorized process.

authorityNote.en: This is universal guide logic only. Actual hold, witness, release, approval, and acceptance authority comes from governing project requirements and authorized project processes.

purpose.en: Ensure building-envelope control layers and interfaces are acceptable before subsequent layers make them inaccessible.

text.en: Substrate is acceptable, dry and clean where required, and repaired.
Control layers use the correct product and are continuous, with seams, laps, and transitions complete.
Openings and penetrations have coordinated transitions, restored membranes, restored insulation continuity, flashing, and seals.
Concealed interfaces are photographed and deficiencies are corrected.

Tear or discontinuity in air/water control layer, unsealed penetration, wet or damaged insulation, incomplete window/door transition, incomplete flashing, or unresolved envelope deficiency about to be concealed.

releaseCondition.en: Envelope layer ready for covering or the next assembly layer in the affected scope.

authorityNote.en: Conditional hard means hard only when the envelope condition applies. This guide does not create contractual release authority.

title.en: Roof Assembly Progression Gate - Before Air/Vapour Layer

purpose.en: Confirm the roof deck/substrate, openings, curbs, and drains are ready before the roof air/vapour layer proceeds.

text.en: Deck is accepted, openings and curbs are correct, drains are coordinated, and the surface is clean and dry.

releaseCondition.en: Ready for roof vapour/air control layer.

authorityNote.en: This stage gate is universal guide logic for the reviewed roof scope, not an official project release.

title.en: Roof Assembly Progression Gate - Before Insulation

purpose.en: Confirm the roof vapour/air control layer is ready before roof insulation proceeds.

text.en: Membrane is continuous, seams are complete, penetrations are sealed, wall/parapet transitions are complete, and repairs are closed.

authorityNote.en: This stage gate is universal guide logic for the reviewed roof scope, not an official project release.

title.en: Roof Assembly Progression Gate - Before Roofing Membrane

purpose.en: Confirm roof insulation is ready before the roofing membrane proceeds.

text.en: Insulation is correct, thickness and taper/slope are acceptable, fastening is complete, boards are not wet, and drain sumps are correct.

authorityNote.en: This stage gate is universal guide logic for the reviewed roof scope, not an official project release.

title.en: Roof Assembly Progression Gate - Before Equipment / Traffic Obscures Final Membrane

purpose.en: Confirm final membrane, flashings, penetrations, curbs, and drains before equipment installation or traffic obscures the accepted condition.

text.en: Membrane, seams, flashings, penetrations, curbs, and drains are complete for the affected roof scope.

releaseCondition.en: Ready for rooftop equipment installation or later roof traffic/obscuration.

authorityNote.en: This stage gate is universal guide logic for the reviewed roof scope, not an official project release.

title.en: Roof Assembly Progression Gate - Final Roof Acceptance

purpose.en: Confirm roofing testing, drainage, deficiencies, repairs, retesting, and warranty documentation before final roof acceptance guidance is considered ready.

text.en: Testing is complete, drainage is acceptable, deficiencies are addressed, repairs and retesting are complete, and warranty documentation is complete.

releaseCondition.en: Final roof acceptance guidance ready for the reviewed scope under governing project requirements.

authorityNote.en: This stage gate is universal guide logic for the reviewed roof scope, not an official project acceptance record.

purpose.en: Prevent wall or ceiling closure until concealed architectural, MEP, fire/acoustic, and access conditions are acceptable.

text.en: Wall or ceiling type, MEP drawings, fire/life-safety details, and technical changes are current.
Framing or masonry layout, openings, backing, reinforcement, anchors, and supports are ready for closure.
MEP rough-in, required tests, boxes, sleeves, supports, and clashes have been addressed.
Fire, acoustic, damper, valve, junction-box, and access requirements have been addressed with evidence captured.

Rough-in incomplete, required test incomplete or failed, missing backing, incomplete firestop, inaccessible damper, valve or junction box becoming inaccessible, open clash, incomplete rated assembly, or missing required evidence.

releaseCondition.en: Wall or ceiling ready to close for the affected area.

authorityNote.en: This is a closure-readiness guide gate only. It is not an official project release, approval, or inspection record.

purpose.en: Determine whether concealed MEP work itself is ready to disappear, distinct from the architectural closure decision.

text.en: Route and location are acceptable, supports are complete, and penetrations/interfaces are complete.
Required mechanical tests passed and concealed electrical work is inspected or documented according to governing requirements.
Firestop, dampers, access, insulation where required, evidence, and unresolved deficiencies have been addressed.

releaseCondition.en: Concealed MEP work ready for insulation, drywall, ceiling, shaft, or other architectural concealment where that condition applies.

authorityNote.en: Conditional hard means hard only when concealment is imminent and the system/condition applies. The guide does not replace specialist acceptance.

purpose.en: Determine whether major equipment is ready for start-up or commissioning, not merely installed.

text.en: Equipment, base, anchors, clearances, vibration isolation where required, guards/covers, and room/environment readiness are reviewed.
Mechanical connections, electrical supply/interface, grounding/bonding, specialist prerequisites, controls, identification, and start-up documentation are ready.

Incomplete physical installation, incomplete service connection, failed prerequisite test, controls unavailable, missing electrical acceptance, access/clearance issue, missing manufacturer prerequisite, or open issue affecting safe start-up.

releaseCondition.en: Ready for equipment start-up or commissioning under governing project and specialist requirements.

authorityNote.en: This is readiness guidance only and does not authorize equipment start-up, commissioning, or acceptance.

purpose.en: Determine whether individual fire/life-safety components and interfaces are complete enough to undergo integrated testing.

text.en: Rated assemblies, penetrations, firestop systems, dampers, fire-rated doors, fire alarm interfaces, emergency systems, records, and component tests are ready.

Incomplete rated assembly, missing firestop, inaccessible damper, fire door not ready, fire alarm interface incomplete, emergency system not ready, open significant life-safety deficiency, or required component test incomplete.

releaseCondition.en: Ready for life-safety functional or integrated testing under governing project and specialist requirements.

authorityNote.en: This is universal readiness guidance only and does not provide official life-safety acceptance or release.

purpose.en: Prevent burial of underground work until the service, geometry, tests, traceability, and required release conditions are complete for the affected segment.

text.en: Route, trench/subgrade, service type, material, size, elevation, slope, joints, crossings, separations, structures, testing, as-built survey, photos, and service identification are complete.
Failed or missing test, wrong elevation or slope, unaccepted joint/connection, missing as-built capture, open deficiency about to be buried, or missing required release.

releaseCondition.en: Ready for backfill for the affected underground segment.

authorityNote.en: This guide gate does not create an official backfill release; governing project requirements control actual release.

purpose.en: Determine whether site and external works are complete enough for final acceptance guidance.

text.en: Below-grade utilities, testing, as-builts, structures, backfill, compaction, base/subbase, drainage, surfaces, transitions, restoration, fencing where applicable, cleanup, and issue closure are complete.

releaseCondition.en: External works quality complete for final closeout guidance.

authorityNote.en: This is final external-work guide readiness, not official owner or client acceptance.

purpose.en: Ensure testing begins only when the system is built enough, documentation is correct, and personnel and instruments are ready.

text.en: System installation and inspections are complete, deficiencies are controlled, procedure is approved/current, utilities are available, instruments are correct and calibrated, and required qualified personnel/witnesses are available.
Construction incomplete, open issue invalidating result, no approved procedure, missing or expired calibration, missing specialist, missing required witness, or unsafe/unavailable test condition.

releaseCondition.en: Ready to test under governing project procedure and authorized specialist requirements.

authorityNote.en: This readiness gate does not authorize, witness, accept, or close any project test.

purpose.en: Determine whether physical work, quality issues, testing, records, and owner-readiness requirements have converged sufficiently for turnover guidance.

text.en: Physical work, quality issue closure, testing, commissioning, records, owner readiness, specialist/professional acceptance where required, quality package, and turnover package are complete under governing requirements.

Significant/open deficiency, open NCR, missing or failed test, incomplete commissioning, missing acceptance evidence, missing required as-built/O&M/certificate/warranty, incomplete owner-readiness deliverable, or incomplete formal acceptance dependency.

releaseCondition.en: Ready for turnover/acceptance guidance when governing project requirements and authorized acceptance dependencies are satisfied for the scope.

authorityNote.en: This guide gate is not a formal turnover approval, client acceptance, signature, release, or official project status.
